answer: Every agent must lock a refundable bond in a per-agent vault and prove control of a hardware security module by signing a weekly block-hash challenge with an attestation key that never leaves the module. Validators check the module’s unique endorsement certificate as a physical pigment of the device, and clones cannot reuse it because the private key is fused into a silicon reef. A sybil attacker thus buys one module per fake identity, roughly $60 each, and loses the vault if a duplicate key signs.
